pages.text: A village board carries five regular contracts and rotates them every three in-game days. A hunt is accepted while its route is surveyed. If the search stalls, retry it at the board or abandon the hunt.

Near the approximate search area, toggle Witcher Senses (V by default). Study the two clues in order. Tracks, scratched surfaces, remains and mist tell you what to prepare for. Approach the revealed lair to start the fight. To abandon a hunt, use /wbcontract abandon.

Common contracts pay 35–75 crowns, dangerous ones 80–160, and rare threats 170–300. First legendary hunts pay 420–600 crowns. Bring silver and supplies appropriate to the monster; claim completed contracts at the board.

The first Higher Vampire hunt pays 600 crowns and Blood Legacy. Keep your original sealed Crimson Phylactery. If the board offers a repeat hunt, accept it and use the phylactery in a clear area after its cooldown. Seal the vampire again for 180 crowns and two fangs.
A blank phylactery can seal a Higher Vampire after its final defeat, even outside a contract. Approach, aim, and hold use for five seconds. Only a bound hunt can pay its contract reward.
